summary: Removing an administrator on the managing tenant now reaches exactly the managed tenants you choose.

new.title: Choose where a removal applies
new.text: When you remove a replicated administrator or row on the managing tenant, the Manager asks whether to remove it in every managed tenant, chosen ones, or none.

new.title: Managed tenants remove the administrator too
new.text: A managed tenant now removes the administrator together with their memberships. Before, only the memberships were removed.

fixes.title: Offboarding still reaches every tenant
fixes.text: An auto-disable date set on the managing tenant still reaches every managed tenant the administrator is in, without asking. Removals from the last 30 days are applied after this update.
